LanguageData.PhobosRadiation_SettingModel: Radiation sickness runs its real course
LanguageData.PhobosRadiation_SettingModelDesc: On by default: radiation is a dose the body slowly repairs, and a large dose brings early sickness, a spell of feeling well, then the illness, which care can see someone through. It takes Dubs Rimatomics' radiation for people in place of its own sickness. Off: Rimatomics' own radiation sickness, as before.
LanguageData.PhobosRadiation_SettingHarshnessDesc: How large a dose kills, and how much care helps. Realistic follows the medical sources.
LanguageData.PhobosRadiation_HarshnessGentleDesc: Half of those dosed die at 6 Gy without care, 9 Gy with full care.
LanguageData.PhobosRadiation_HarshnessModerateDesc: Half die at 5 Gy without care, 7.5 Gy with full care.
LanguageData.PhobosRadiation_HarshnessRealisticDesc: Half die at 4 Gy without care, 6 Gy with full care, as the medical sources say.
LanguageData.PhobosRadiation_HarshnessHarshDesc: Half die at 3.5 Gy without care, 5 Gy with full care.
LanguageData.PhobosRadiation_SettingEstimate: A doctor estimates a dose until it can be measured
LanguageData.PhobosRadiation_SettingEstimateDesc: On by default: until Dubs Rimatomics' portable radiation detectors are researched (or without Rimatomics), a dose shows only as a doctor's estimate, from how soon the person vomited, and closer after two days in a hospital bed. Off: every dose shows exactly.
LanguageData.PhobosRadiation_TipExact: Dose now: {EFFECTIVE} Gy after repair; {LIFETIME} Gy over a lifetime. Exposure category {CATEGORY}.
LanguageData.PhobosRadiation_TipEstimate: A doctor's estimate: about {LOW} to {HIGH} Gy. Exposure category {CATEGORY}, if the estimate is right.
LanguageData.PhobosRadiation_TipUnknown: Exposed to radiation; how much is not known without a radiation counter. Exposure category {CATEGORY}.
